decision: NO-GO for the proposed quantitative diagnostic-rule question before values.
independent_reason: The actual primary qualifies delayed FDG classification for low-uptake/low-grade lesions, acknowledges pure-myxoid selection exclusions and requires biopsy regardless of metabolic activity. It does not promise that every low-uptake lesion is benign. A low-FDG EMC exception would therefore not refute that rule and would repeat prior EMC metabolic heterogeneity rather than add the claimed consequential diagnostic evidence.
source_validity: Same-scanner early/delayed SUVmax and retention-index methods exist, but no source-linked native EMC same-ROI paired measurement is authenticated. Generic soft-tissue metastatic chondrosarcoma remains pending; liposarcoma is not automatically MLPS. Aggregate subtype fields cannot become donor-level controls.
coverage: All11 identified native FDG source records retain their actual metadata/reused/pending status. These are source records, not11 independently authenticated patients or complete full-body coverage. Prior MRI/TCIA/QIN, paired-case, treatment and cohort-overlap limits remain unchanged. Treatment-response ROIs cannot become untreated diagnostic controls.
strongest_alternatives: Grade/site/therapy/uptake timing/partial-volume and ROI protocol differences
Repeated lesions/source overlap rather than independent donors
specific_reopening: An authenticated public native EMC paired early/delayed same-ROI SUVmax/protocol and individual control map, plus a useful conditional clinical question the original authors did not already answer. Fixed units/selection/uncertainty/disproof and root before-values authorization required; no arbitrary benign threshold or new image stage.
review_scope: One independent before-values source/prior-art/usefulness challenge of the exact frozen compact gate. No new primary retrieval, outcome access, cutoff, statistic, hypothesis or whole-paper review.
no_universal_veto: A limited empirical RNA, protein, imaging or metabolite comparison may be useful without universal protein validation or same-donor pairing. Required controls depend on the actual estimand.
promotion: NO. Suitable public evidence and identity/control/assay gaps remain pending; source eligibility itself is not a publication-worthy finding.
campaign: Goal unmet; search not exhausted; existing GPNMB candidate remains held and TMEM266 shelved.
